tagline: Cut metal letters on a knee mill, fill word orders, and grow a factory.
description:
Mill-ionaire is a letter shop tycoon built around a simulated knee mill. Customers post word orders, every word has to be made from letters cut in one finish like brass or blue anodize, and shipping an order pays cash.

Tap run the order program and the mill loads a blank, cuts the letters your orders are missing and drops them into the bins. Or cut by hand with the wheels and sliders. Ship orders when every tile is ready, buy new finishes, hire operators and bolt down floor mills that work the order queue on their own. Once you own a floor mill, callers phone in spoken orders that you spell out for a premium.

The free demo runs your own mill and two floor mills with every finish and order type they bring in. Buy it to unlock more floor mills, the engine lathe, the press brake, five axis CNCs, printers, the warehouse and the office.

Plays in your phone or desktop browser. Your shop saves as you go.
